messages:
zoe (People Ops): Quick plan: Sunbeam recognition pouches for June batch. Need assembly volunteers, shipping plan, and budget confirmation.
harry (Events): I can run SF assembly on 6/13 9-11am. How many kits?
zoe (People Ops): Counts: SF 22, NY 15, Remote 30. Total 67. Contents: enamel pin, sticker, snack, 1-line handwritten note card, "do not open" sticker.
lin (Logistics): Recommend split builds by office. I'll handle NY shipping and remote label printing. Need final CSV by 6/11 EOD.
mica (Finance): Use budget code 6-CULT-2026. Flag me if unit cost > $15. Vendor already invoiced for pins per procurement note.
supply-bot: Inventory check: stickers 200, snack packs 80, blank cards 100, bubble mailers 50.
harry (Events): Volunteers so far: harry, aisha, ray. Need two more for SF.
zoe (People Ops): I'll ping culture-ambassadors to fill spots. Also need someone to QA the recipient CSV (dedupe + address format).
lin (Logistics): Happy to QA the CSV. I'll run postal validation and dedupe; will post cleaned file by 6/11 noon.
mica (Finance): Confirmed spend estimate ~ $820 under 6-CULT-2026. No extra approvals needed.
harry (Events): Assembly checklist:
- Print blank cards + manager guide line
- Pack pin, sticker, snack, card
- Add "do not open" sticker for surprise deliveries
- Photograph 2 sample kits and upload to #culture-photos
- Label shipments for remote

zoe (People Ops): Managers will hand-write notes. We'll provide a one-liner guide. Also please bring extra pens.
harry (Events): I'll bring pens + label printer. Table reserved SF lounge 9-11am.
lin (Logistics): NY pack on 6/12 6-8pm. I'll bring bubble mailers for remotes.
zoe (People Ops): Final timeline: 6/11 CSV QA -> 6/12 NY pack -> 6/13 SF pack -> 6/14 remote ship. Thanks all!
